nusmp.skill.grimoire_butoh.description: Grimoire magic: Butoh Magic. Butoh Magic is the magic of the dance: the caster moves, and the movement becomes water, rhythm and flying slashes. Its pages sweep flowing water blades, beat out waves that shove enemies and jam their casting, throw the Sea God Slash, slip away in an evasion step, enter a trance that speeds up and hardens the dancer and allies, veil the caster in tidal water, drag foes into a whirlpool, raise a stage of rhythm that buffs allies and breaks enemy casting, call down the Sea God's Descent, and once a day perform the Seabed Hymn that heals allies and sweeps enemies back. Hold the grimoire, hold the skill key to chant, release to cast.
nusmp.skill.book_butoh.description: The grimoire of Butoh Magic: eleven pages of dance. Starters throw a dance strike and sweep two arcs of water; mid pages beat a rhythm wave, throw the Sea God Slash, step away from danger, enter a trance and raise a tidal veil; the zone pages are the Undertow whirlpool and the Metronome Field; the signature is the Sea God's Descent; the daily is the Seabed Hymn. Water slows and shoves, rhythm buffs allies and silences enemies. Hold the grimoire, hold the skill key to chant, release to cast.
nusmp.page.book_butoh.butoh_strike: The simplest step of the dance: a hand thrown out, and the movement leaves it as a bolt. It flies straight, passes through enemies, and deals 8 damage to each one it touches.
nusmp.page.book_butoh.butoh_flowing_blad: The dancer turns, and the water turns with them: two arcs follow one another like a single slow breath. The first sweep hits everything in a 5.5 block cone in front of you for 7 water damage, the second, 7 ticks later along your new facing, for 5. Each hit slows the target (Slowness II, 2.5 s) and pushes it back.
nusmp.page.book_butoh.butoh_rhythm_wave: Heel on the ground, three beats, and the air carries them outwards. Three shockwaves leave you 8 ticks apart, each hitting everything within 6 blocks for 3.5 water damage and shoving it back. The third beat also jams enemy casting (Magic Jamming, 4 s, 1 s on bosses) and slows them. Allies in range gain Speed I with every beat.
nusmp.page.book_butoh.butoh_sea_god_slas: Union Magic of the Seabed Temple: the swords carry a great aura, and every swing throws a shockwave and flying slashes in worship of the Sea God. A shockwave 2 blocks ahead hits for 5 and shoves hard, then three piercing water slashes fly out in a fan, 26 blocks, 10 damage to each enemy (each enemy is hit once per cast), slowing and pushing them.
nusmp.page.book_butoh.butoh_ebb_step: As the tide goes out, so does the dancer. You slip up to 7 blocks backwards, away from your facing, and leave a wet afterimage: mobs hunting you lose your trail, and everything within 2.8 blocks of where you stood is slowed (Slowness II, 2 s) and pushed. You gain Resistance III for 1.5 s and Speed II for 3 s.
nusmp.page.book_butoh.butoh_trance_dance: The longer the dancer dances, the less they are there. For 30 s you move with Speed II, your melee hits deal +3 damage, and about one blow in five finds nobody where it lands (it deals no damage). Allies within 10 blocks catch the rhythm: Speed I and Strength I for 20 s.
nusmp.page.book_butoh.butoh_tidal_veil: A curtain of water follows every motion of the sleeves. For 8 s you take less damage (Resistance II) and gain Absorption II, anything that strikes you is splashed for 2 damage in return, and arrows and spells that come within 3.5 blocks are washed away. Casting it shoves nearby enemies back 3.5 blocks and slows them.
nusmp.page.book_butoh.butoh_undertow: The dancer draws a slow circle on the floor, and the sea answers. A whirlpool 5 blocks wide forms at the spot you look at and lasts 6 s: every half second it deals 2.5 water damage, slows (Slowness III) and drags enemies toward the centre (bosses are not dragged). At the end it surges for 9 damage and throws them up.
nusmp.page.book_butoh.butoh_metronome_fi: A stage with a heartbeat. For 10 s a field 7 blocks wide stays where you cast it. Every second, allies in it gain Speed I and Strength I; enemies take 2 water damage, lose their casting rhythm (Magic Jamming, 2 s, 1 s on bosses), are slowed and weakened, and lose 1% of their magicules.
nusmp.page.book_butoh.butoh_sea_god_desc: The Sea God of the Seabed Temple is called down by a dance too slow to interrupt. The spot you look at (28 blocks) is marked by a 7 block ring; 1.2 s later the sea crashes down there for 22 water damage, throws enemies up, shoves them and slows them (Slowness IV, 4 s). 8 ticks after, an echo sweeps a wider 9.8 block ring for 8 damage.
nusmp.page.book_butoh.butoh_seabed_hymn: The worship dance performed at the bottom of the sea, once a day. It washes over 10 blocks: allies are healed for 35% of their maximum health, cleansed of harmful effects, and gain Regeneration II and Resistance I for 10 s. Enemies in range take 10 water damage, are swept back, slowed and have their casting jammed for 5 s (1 s on bosses). Cooldown 10 minutes.
